note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目；術語表沒有獨立的條目，英文名稱依一般用法。故事的電腦設備依教材記在機器設備。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the glossary has no separate entry and the English name follows common usage. The computers in the story are recorded under machinery and equipment.

definition.zh-TW: 辦公室用的設備，例如電腦與印表機。只給需要另列辦公設備的延伸題使用。
definition.en: Equipment used in the office, such as computers and printers. It is used only in extension exercises that present office equipment separately.
